**The paper does not report this.** It never applies SimPO to Llama-3-70B.

What the document does say:

- **Llama-3-70B appears only as a reference model.** In Table 1, Llama-3-70B-Instruct is listed from the AlpacaEval 2 leaderboard at a 34.4% LC win rate (p. 1). It is not a model the authors trained; bold marks their own models, and this one isn't bold.
- **SimPO was applied to smaller models.** The authors trained with Llama-3-8B, Mistral-7B and Gemma-2-9B (p. 4).
- **The closest result is Llama-3-8B-Instruct with SimPO:**
  - 44.7% LC win rate in the original setup (Table 1, p. 1; Table 4, p. 6).
  - 53.7% LC win rate in the v0.2 setup, which uses the stronger ArmoRM reward model (Table 12, p. 29).
